title: The Power of a Speech
text:
A speech is a formal talk that a person gives to an audience. Speeches are often given at weddings, graduations, and important events. A good speaker uses a clear voice and speaks slowly so that everyone can understand the message. Many speakers practise their speech many times before the big day.

Some speeches are very famous because they changed the way people think. For example, a leader may use a speech to encourage people to work together. The speaker often uses short sentences and repeats important words. This helps the audience remember the main idea after the speech ends.

questions.text: According to the passage, where are speeches often given?
options: At weddings, graduations, and important events

questions.text: According to the passage, what can a leader do with a speech?
options: Sell expensive products in a shop

questions.text: Why do many speakers practise their speech before the event?
options: So they can deliver it clearly and with confidence
Because speeches must always be read from paper
To make the speech longer than planned

questions.text: Why is a famous speech still remembered years later?
options: It changed the way people think
It was printed on a very small card
It was given in a room with no audience
It was shorter than other speeches

vocabulary.definition: a formal talk given to an audience
the people who listen to or watch a speech or performance
to give someone support or confidence to do something
to repeat an activity many times to get better at it

paragraph_translations: Konuşma, bir kişinin dinleyici kitlesine yaptığı resmi bir sözlü sunumdur. Konuşmalar genellikle düğünlerde, mezuniyetlerde ve önemli etkinliklerde yapılır. İyi bir konuşmacı, herkesin mesajı anlayabilmesi için net bir ses kullanır ve yavaş konuşur. Birçok konuşmacı, konuşmasını büyük günden önce defalarca prova eder.

Bazı konuşmalar insanların düşünme biçimini değiştirdikleri için çok ünlüdür. Örneğin bir lider, insanları birlikte çalışmaya teşvik etmek için konuşma yapabilir. Konuşmacı genellikle kısa cümleler kullanır ve önemli kelimeleri tekrarlar. Bu, konuşma bittikten sonra dinleyicilerin ana fikri hatırlamasına yardımcı olur.
